description: Changes a process-wide lazy cache from storing the in-flight Promise to storing resolved settings. The original implementation shares one load between concurrent callers. The proposed implementation leaves cached undefined while awaiting disk I/O, introducing duplicate concurrent loads and last-writer-wins assignment.

bugs.description: The old implementation cached the in-flight Promise before another caller could enter. The new check-then-await sequence lets two callers pass the undefined check, both read settings, and overwrite each other's result. Preserve single-flight loading by retaining the shared in-flight Promise.
